title: Understanding the True Model
text: In the context of the problem, $f_{\theta**{*}}(x)$ represents the true underlying linear model that generates the response vector $Y$ from the design matrix $X$. This model is fixed and does not change.

title: Role of $\theta**{*}$
text: The parameter $\theta**{*}$ is a fixed parameter in the true model. It does not change with different datasets or splits.

title: Fixed Nature of $f_{\theta**{*}}(x)$
